deleteAccountBody: Permanently deletes your account and removes your name, contact details and messages. Payment and payout amounts stay in circle records, shown to other members as "Deleted User".
deleteConfirmBody:
Are you sure you want to permanently delete your account? This cannot be undone.

• Your name, email, phone and sign-in details are removed or anonymized.
• Your messages and payment notes are cleared.
• Payment and payout amounts and dates stay in the circle record, shown to other members as "Deleted User".
• Copies in backups can remain for up to about 90 days.
deletedBody: Your account has been deleted and anonymized.

deleteBlockedGooglePlayBody: Your Organizer Pro subscription is billed by Google Play. Open Google Play > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions, cancel it, then come back to delete your account.
deleteBlockedCirclesBody_one: You organize {{count}} open circle. Finish, archive or delete it so members are not left without an organizer, then try again.
deleteBlockedCirclesBody_other: You organize {{count}} open circles. Finish, archive or delete them so members are not left without an organizer, then try again.

deleteBlockedSettleBody_other: You have contributions that are due and not yet paid in {{count}} circles. Pay them, then delete your account. If you cannot, email support@circusave.com and we will help.
